newsitem.title: JORDAN: Jordan shares fall despite hotel, garment gains.
newsitem.headline: Jordan shares fall despite hotel, garment gains.

text.p: Shares on the Amman stock exchange fell 0.32 percent on Monday in trade dominated by a handful of block purchases, brokers said.
The official Amman Financial Market 60-share index dropped 0.49 points to 153.54 points in moderate turnover of 604,000 dinars ($853,000).
Heavily traded clothes manufacturers El-Zay Ready Wear and Arab International Hotels both rose by 0.05 dinars to 1.95 dinars and 4.65 dinars.
Brokers said foreign fund managers were thought to be behind some of the demand for the two companies, which between them accounted for nearly half of Monday's turnover.
More block trades in Jordan Phosphate Manufacturers and Jordan Cement Company, which released upbeat reports on their 1996 revenues earlier this month, boosted turnover in the two companies.
But brokers said there was little excitement on the trading floor as the Moslem fasting month of Ramadan took its traditional toll on traders' activities.
"There is no attendance by the investors," said Nasser al-Amad, head of the United Financial Investors.

Despite the strong showing from El-Zay and Arab International Hotels, falling shares outnumbered gainers by 21 to six. Blue chip Arab Bank, which is heavily weighted on the AFM index, fell 0.50 dinars to 255.50 dinars, helping push the official index down.
The private Pearl Investable Index of the 45 best performing shares on the exchange fell a more modest 0.16 percent to 81.81 points.
